subject: M2 kernel extraction at Aeneas 1238879f (Charon 9e95cf31; whole noble-kernel crate, Rust subject 7f63e9d0): 2,271 generated and 73 external definitions; re-derived 2026-11-21 for the LIVE round-3 live test-host validation rule so the M2 subject carries the same bytes as the current M3 kernel, carrying reviewed status, citations and notes by Lean name. Generated definitions are extracted except the fixture-checked acceptance::check (its thirteen citations are unchanged); external definitions are modeled except the five #[charon::opaque] helpers.

functions.note: Fixture-checked, not proved: the 12 cited fixture correspondences are closed native_decide equalities between the extracted checker and the reference model on one request and candidate each, and accepted_via_refinement is conditional on the refinement equation it is cited for. No citation is a strict universal statement, so universal checker correctness is not established (#88). Since #97 compares adapter identities as byte arrays and keeps the join assertions without messages, the checker no longer depends on generated literal-size axioms: the fixtures keep the native axiom class through native_decide, and accepted_via_refinement uses only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound.
